description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for interacting with the Gmail API, including managing drafts, messages, labels, and threads. It includes schema definitions, base classes, and factory functions to create specific Gmail tools based on requested actions.

classes.name: BaseGmailTool
classes.description: A base class for Gmail API tools, providing request handling and MIME message creation.

methods.name: createGmailTools
methods.description: Factory function to create Gmail tool instances based on specified actions and parameters.
